tasks.subject: Task 1: Image primitives (asset_key, normalize_to_png, placeholder)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Create the assets module with pure image primitives + image-crate dep (avif-native) + flake dav1d.

**Files:** create crates/inkapp-core/src/assets.rs; modify crates/inkapp-core/src/lib.rs, crates/inkapp-core/Cargo.toml, flake.nix

**Verify:** nix develop --command cargo test -p inkapp-core assets::tests

```json:metadata
{"files":["crates/inkapp-core/src/assets.rs","crates/inkapp-core/src/lib.rs","crates/inkapp-core/Cargo.toml","flake.nix"],"verifyCommand":"nix develop --command cargo test -p inkapp-core assets::tests","acceptanceCriteria":["asset_key 16 hex stable","asset_path format","normalize drops <=2px & transcodes jpeg/webp/avif/png to PNG","PLACEHOLDER_PNG is 1x1 PNG"]}
```
